attempted_claim: Prove or disprove the following root-free equal-stretch principal rigidity statement: let phi, psi in Out(F5) be primitive root-free principal ageometric atoroidal fully irreducible elements whose ideal Whitehead graphs are the disjoint union of eight triangles on twelve periodic directions, with equal stretch factor lambda_phi=lambda_psi=lambda and equal stretch-factor minimal polynomial; if there is a graph isomorphism W(phi)->W(psi) preserving the periodic-direction labeling up to a marked-graph automorphism, then phi is conjugate in Out(F5) to psi; a complete answer is either a proof that this combined Whitehead plus equal-stretch-minpoly data determines the conjugacy class among root-free principal atoroidals in rank 5, or an explicit counterexample pair of train-track maps on a fixed rank-5 marked graph with computed isomorphic eight-triangle ideal Whitehead graphs, certificates of principal ageometric atoroidal root-free fully irreducible status, certified equal stretch factors with equal minimal polynomials, and a rigorous non-conjugacy certificate via attracting-lamination, boundary fixed-point, or train-track-automaton invariants that cannot be a proper-power pair.
decisive_failure: value: ADMISSION_DEFECT: the resolution is vacuous truth from an unsatisfiable hypothesis exposing a cheap type/vacuity defect that Admission should have ruled out per STANDARD: 8 disjoint triangles need 24 vertices versus 12 directions, and principal rank-5 needs 7 triangles not 8. This is elementary counting plus definitions, not a substantive rigidity theorem, new invariant, census, or natural-object exact value with motivated downstream use. Correct and new but intrinsically low-value arbitrary-parameter fact.
